subject: Request: Penetration test report & MAP deadline — BrightBridge Health renewal
messages:
From: Procurement <procurement@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@brightbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Pen test report required for MAP gating / renewal

Hi Tessa,

As part of our renewal gating for BrightBridge Health (MAP review), our security and procurement teams require a copy of your latest penetration test report covering the production inference endpoints and any public-facing management consoles. We need the report and a remediation summary by 2027-09-20 to keep the renewal on track.

Specifically we need:
- The most recent penetration test report (redacted is acceptable if it omits vendor-specific IP addresses and internal hostnames)
- A remediation tracker mapping open findings to status and ETA
- Confirmation of whether the test covered 3rd-party dependencies (Open-source libs, 3rd-party auth, etc.)

If you can’t provide the report by the 20th please let us know immediately; our procurement team will need to evaluate the impact on the MAP gating timeline.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Senior Manager, Procurement
BrightBridge Health

--
Attachment: none (link to portal suggested)

Laura / Karthik,

Looping you both in — BrightBridge is asking for the latest pen test and remediation tracker by 9/20 to meet MAP gating for the renewal. Can we share a redacted report + the tracker? If not, what is the earliest we can produce a redacted version and is there any outstanding remediation that we should call out?

Thanks,

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: (bcc none)
Date: 2027-09-13T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pen test report required for MAP gating / renewal

Tessa — thanks for the heads up.

Summary of where we are (security update):
- Pen test completed 2027-09-10 by Red Oak Security (3rd-party vendor). Scope included: production inference endpoints (API load balancers), admin console (internal auth flow), and cloud management plane (GCP projects for hosted infra).
- We have prepared a redacted PDF that removes internal hostnames, IPs, and specific exploit POCs. Redacted report attached.
- Remediation tracker attached (remediation_tracker_v3.xlsx) — currently 9 findings: 6 closed, 2 in-progress, 1 low-severity design finding with long-term remediation (Q4).
- Third-party libraries were included in the assessment (see appendix B). No critical OSS supply-chain issues were observed.

Open items to call out to BrightBridge:
- Finding #7: outdated SSO library used in a non-prod admin preview service — remediation ETA 2027-10-05 (in-progress, patching scheduled).
- Finding #9: weak cookie flags on a legacy management endpoint — mitigated in prod via WAF rule (temporary), full fix scheduled for 2027-09-28.

Sharing policy and next steps:
- We can provide the redacted report and the remediation tracker under our standard procurement share. For access to the full, unredacted report we require either: (a) a mutual NDA or (b) an in-person/executive readout with Red Oak Security & Redwood security present.
- I recommend we send BrightBridge the redacted report + tracker now and request a 48-72 hour extension of the MAP gating deadline to allow them to review and execute an NDA if they want the full report.

Attachments: redacted_pen_test_report_20270910.pdf; remediation_tracker_v3.xlsx

Laura Bennett
Head of Information Security, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment stubs: redacted_pen_test_report_20270910.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB, redacted), remediation_tracker_v3.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@brightbridgehealth.com>, Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-15T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Redacted pen test report + remediation tracker (BrightBridge MAP gating)

Hi Maya / Aaron,

Thanks for the note and for flagging the MAP gating timeline. Attached is the redacted penetration test report (completed 2027-09-10) and our remediation tracker. The tracker maps each finding to status, owner, and ETA. Key callouts:

- 6 of 9 findings are closed; 2 are in-progress with active mitigations; 1 is a low-severity design item with a Q4 remediation plan.
- The assessment included 3rd-party/open-source coverage (see appendix B in the report). No critical OSS issues were found.

We can provide the full unredacted report once BrightBridge executes a mutual NDA or schedules a secured readout with Red Oak Security and Redwood Security on short notice. To ensure the renewal process stays on schedule, would BrightBridge consider a short MAP gating extension to 2027-09-22 to allow time for review and, if needed, NDA execution? That gives us room to coordinate the full disclosure path if required.

Attachments: redacted_pen_test_report_20270910.pdf; remediation_tracker_v3.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm you received the redacted report and tracker.
2) If you need the unredacted report, confirm whether your legal/procurement team will sign a mutual NDA or prefer a readout meeting.
3) Notify us regarding the MAP gating extension — we requested 9/22.

Happy to set up a 30-min call this week for a quick walk-through.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0192
E: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: redacted_pen_test_report_20270910.pdf (attached), remediation_tracker_v3.xlsx (attached)

Tessa — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the clear tracker. We received the redacted report and the remediation spreadsheet.

We will accept the redacted report for initial MAP gating and are prepared to grant a short extension on the gating deadline to 2027-09-22 to allow our security team time to review. To access the full unredacted report, Procurement requires a signed mutual NDA (standard template) and a short call with Red Oak Security for any technical questions.

Action items for both sides:
- BrightBridge: will circulate our standard mutual NDA via DocuSign today (expecting signature by 9/19).
- Redwood: please be ready to produce Red Oak contact details and schedule a 45-min technical readout the week of 9/20 if we execute the NDA.

HubSpot: I’ve added a note to the deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/BB-2027-MAP-43).

Thanks,
Maya Singh
